source: Meta Graph API v25/v26 - Page node, Page Insights (/{page-id}/insights), Page Post node and Post Insights (/{post-id}/insights)

tables.name: fbpage_Page
tables.grain: one row per page per day (current state = _DATA_DATE = _LATEST_DATE)

tables.name: fbpage_Post
tables.grain: one row per post per _DATA_DATE snapshot (lifetime metrics restated)

tables.name: fbpage_Demographics
tables.grain: page x day x segment_type x segment_value
